items.title: Arzu Hatakoy
items.dc:creator: Elayne Wangalwa
items.content:
Arzu Hatakoy
Head of Office, Syria
Elayne Wangalwa 9 Sep. 2026 1.22 p.m.

Arzu Hatakoy was appointed as Head of Office, Syria, in August 2026. She brings 20 years of experience in humanitarian-development-peace coordination in complex and high-risk environments. Prior to this role, Arzu served as Principal Coordination Officer with the UN Assistance Mission to Afghanistan (UNAMA) and head of RCO in Kabul, where she provided strategic leadership in advancing UN system-wide coordination and strengthening engagement with de facto authorities and international stakeholders. She also previously led the UNAMA Office in Herat. Arzu started her UN career with OCHA in 2007, where she held several positions, including as Deputy Head of Office in Gaziantep, Türkiye. She has worked on large-scale humanitarian responses, particularly in the Middle East and Africa. Arzu also served with the UN Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process in Jerusalem. In addition to her UN experience, she led the GIZ Syria Peace Initiative project based in Beirut. Arzu holds a Doctorate in Political Science from the Free University of Berlin, a Master in Public Administration from Harvard Kennedy School and a Master in International Relations from Sciences Po Paris. A German national, Arzu is fluent in English and French, a native speaker of German and Turkish, and has beginners’ level of Persian and Arabic.
